title: 第4章 她不用管了？
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 一直看着巴儿姐进村，徐喜弟才放心回去割菜。等背着一筐猪菜回村，已经是午后了。换平时起的早，中午之前就能回到家。家里养了三头猪，她每天都要去割一上午的猪菜才够吃。不论刮风下雨。进村第三户人家，就是刘烨家，泥胚房，茅顶。他正端着一个脸盆，坐在自家门口吃饭。因为粮食不够吃，不给人干活的时候，他一天只吃一顿饭。看到徐喜弟背着菜筐从门口路过，他跟往常一样打招呼。“喜弟，才回来啊。”“嗯。”徐喜弟应了一声。从前，两人的招呼就到此为止。但今天刘烨把脸盆往台阶上一放，多问了一句。“看你脸色不太好，重吗？我帮你吧？”说着，就要起身上前帮忙。这可把徐喜弟吓了一大跳，“不用，叔你吃饭吧，不重，我自己能行。”想到昨夜进她屋的人可能就是他，徐喜弟就心慌。他们还是少点接触比较好，否则那层窗户纸一旦捅破，可就太尴尬了。再说，让人看见他们走太近，又得说闲话。刘烨看她加快步伐逃一样进村，抓了抓头后，端起脸盆进屋继续吃饭。……徐喜弟回到家，本来没多累，因为这回走得有点快，大气直喘，衣服前胸后背都被汗透了。巴儿姐像个没事儿人一样，从后院的菜园子里摘了两片牛耳菜，在堂屋里逗小鸡仔。放下菜筐，徐喜弟挥着汗进屋换湿衣，发现张永福还没抱回来。难道是等她回来弄？换好衣服出来，就看到范金花提着一斤肉从外面进门。“喜弟，割菜回来了？”范金花面带微笑，跟徐喜弟说话，感觉像在讨好。“嗯，您买肉去了？今天过什么节吗？”徐喜弟看着她手里的肉，是五花的。家里除了逢年过节会吃好肉，平日吃油只买板油回来炼，油渣一次都没舍得多吃。巴儿姐看到肉，眼睛就发亮，手里的菜叶子直接扔地上，站起来指肉块。“阿巴，阿巴……”范金花也没理。“你爸馋肉了，非让我今天去。”一口大锅毫不犹豫就甩给了张国海。“呃。”徐喜弟点了点头，管她呢，只要有肉吃，她就高兴。应完话，她往隔壁房门瞟了一眼，门关着，里面感觉好像有点安静。范金花像是看懂了她的意思，连忙开口解释。“亦福脾气大，怕他吵你，先让他冷静几天。这几天让你爸伺候他，你就别管了。”啊？这么好？意思可以休息几天了？徐喜弟似乎还不敢信，怔怔看着范金花。“你今天帮我剁猪菜吧，你爸估计没什么空，我现在去把肉炖上。”范金花交代完，提着肉进火房去了。巴儿姐拍着掌，一蹦一跳跟进去。徐喜弟站在堂屋中央，看看隔壁房门，又看看墙角的那一筐猪菜。剁猪菜可比伺候张永福轻松多了！行啊，只要不用伺候人，别说剁猪菜，就是煮猪食加喂猪，都问题不大！于是她拉了一个小板凳，坐过去，咔咔咔就飞快干起来。……晚饭，张永福没有出现在火房一起吃饭。张国海先盛了半碗肉给他送过去，然后骂骂咧咧声就从公婆房间里传出来。“让徐喜弟来，不然我就不吃！”“她是不是没脸来见我！”“我要回自己的屋！贱人，我要打死她！”没多久，张国海黑着一张脸出来，把肉碗往灶上重重一放。“我们先吃，让他饿，还治不了他？！”徐喜弟不用伺候那个暴脾气的猴，一脸轻松自在，还有炖烂的五花肉吃。很香！特别香！范金花给她分了半碗肉，连肉带汤满满一碗。巴儿姐只分到了一碗汤和两片肉，很不满，委屈巴巴地鼓着嘴，也不肯吃，就盯着徐喜弟的碗看。徐喜弟被盯得有些难以下咽，于是从自己碗里拨了一半过去，巴儿姐这才逐笑颜开，美美地吃起来。吃饱喝足，这次巴儿姐勤快地主动去洗碗。徐喜弟几年来还是第一次晚饭后，这么轻松自在。上床后，她在床上还滚了两滚，没有张永福，日子真美好！要是能一直这样，就好了！她香香甜甜地入了梦。梦里，她看到了高楼，看到了五花八门的商店，听说外面的世界都长这样。她兴高采烈推门进去，却一头撞在一堵肉墙上。她想抬头看，不但啥也看不清，甚至还有些呼吸困难。她吓得睁大双眼。这才发现，自己被一座大山盘得严严实实。什么？今晚还来？黑暗中，她两手往对方身上推了推，还是那个熟悉的胸膛，和臂膀。徐喜弟松了一口气。很快，床板就吱吱呀呀摇摆起来。……隔壁的范金花和张国海，总算知道为什么儿子脾气那么大。昨晚他们离得远只听见一些小动静。今晚离得近，只隔着一面板墙，有一个只有喂猪的人才听过的，pia pia吃食一样的动静，不绝于耳。暗夜里，范金花默默把手伸进被窝。说来她也才四十四岁，生完一双儿女，就再也没有做过女人。她狠狠地往张国海腰上一掐。“哎！你……”张国海正听得入木，突然被冷不丁这么一掐，疼得叫出声来。范金花连忙捂住他的嘴，这人，要坏事！果然，隔壁停了下来。……徐喜弟直接被吓了一个激灵，惊得下意识双手往后一撑，半坐起身。对方似乎被她的举动惊到了，两人在黑暗中对峙了一分钟。过了好一阵，他干脆搂住她。床板又悄悄开始摇摆。到最后，他又是猝不及防地，突然利落翻身离开。徐喜弟拉着被子，给自己盖严实，然后沉沉睡过去。真够久的！好累呢……范金花的手，在被子里捞了捞，很失望。要是没有这次经历，她都不知道，原来男人和男人，真的大不同。一个只能数到十。一个能从九点钟数到十二点。张国海把被子一裹，屁股对着她，范金花只能勉强扯了一个角，盖住自己的肚子。她的命好苦，还有五个这样的晚上！
content_en: After watching Sister Ba'er enter the village, Xu Xidi felt relieved and went back to cut vegetables.By the time I returned to the village carrying a basket of pig vegetables, it was already afternoon.If I usually get up early, I can get home before noon.There are three pigs at home, and she has to cut pig vegetables for a whole morning every day to have enough food.Come rain or shine.The third house in the village is Liu Ye's house, which has a mud house with a thatched roof.He was holding a basin and sitting in front of his house eating.Because there was not enough food to eat, he only ate one meal a day when he was not working for others.Seeing Xu Xidi passing by the door carrying a vegetable basket, he greeted him as usual."Xidi, you just came back." "Yes." Xu Xidi responded.In the past, the greetings between the two of them ended there.But today Liu Ye put the washbasin on the steps and asked one more question."You don't look good. Are you serious? Can I help you?" As he said that, he got up and stepped forward to help.This shocked Xu Xidi, "No, uncle, just eat. It's not heavy, I can do it by myself." Thinking that the person who entered her room last night might be him, Xu Xidi panicked.It would be better for them to have less contact, otherwise it would be too embarrassing once the window paper is pierced.Besides, if people saw them walking too close, they would have to gossip.Liu Ye saw her speeding up and running into the village. After scratching his head, he picked up the washbasin and went into the house to continue eating....Xu Xidi was not too tired when he got home, because he walked a little too fast this time, he was panting, and the front, chest and back of his clothes were soaked with sweat.Sister Ba'er acted like a carefree person, picking two pieces of cabbage from the vegetable garden in the backyard, and playing with the chickens in the main room.After putting down the vegetable basket, Xu Xidi went into the house to change into wet clothes, sweating, and found that Zhang Yongfu hadn't brought it back yet.Are you waiting for her to come back?After changing clothes and coming out, she saw Fan Jinhua coming in from outside carrying a pound of meat."Xidi, are you back from cutting vegetables?" Fan Jinhua smiled and talked to Xu Xidi, feeling like she was trying to please him."Well, have you bought meat? Are you celebrating any festival today?" Xu Xidi looked at the meat in her hand. It was streaky.In addition to eating good meat during festivals and festivals, my family only buys suet for cooking on weekdays, and I never eat more oil residue.Sister Ba'er's eyes lit up when she saw the meat. She threw the vegetable leaves in her hand to the ground and stood up to point at the pieces of meat."Aba, Aba..." Fan Jinhua ignored him."Your dad is hungry for meat and insisted on letting me go today." He handed the big pot to Zhang Guohai without hesitation."Uh." Xu Xidi nodded. It didn't matter to her, as long as she had meat to eat, she would be happy.After answering, she glanced at the door of the next door. The door was closed, and it seemed a little quiet inside.Fan Jinhua seemed to understand what she meant and quickly explained."Yifu has a bad temper. You are afraid that he will disturb you, so let him calm down for a few days. Let your dad take care of him these days, and just leave him alone." Huh?so good?Do you mean you can rest for a few days?Xu Xidi seemed to still not believe it and looked at Fan Jinhua blankly."You can chop the pigs and vegetables for me today. Your dad probably won't have much time. I'm going to stew the meat now." After Fan Jinhua finished her explanation, she carried the meat into the fire room.Sister Ba'er clapped her hands and followed with a jump.Xu Xidi stood in the middle of the main room, looked at the door next door, and then at the basket of pig vegetables in the corner.Chopping pigs and vegetables is much easier than serving Zhang Yongfu!Okay, as long as you don’t have to wait on anyone, let alone chop pigs and vegetables, it’s not a big problem if you just cook pig food and feed the pigs!So she pulled up a small bench, sat on it, and started fucking her quickly....At dinner, Zhang Yongfu did not appear in the fire room to eat together.Zhang Guohai first filled half a bowl of meat and sent it to him, and then curses could be heard from his parents-in-law's room."Let Xu Xidi come, or I won't eat!" "Does she have no face to see me?" "I want to go back to my room! Bitch, I'm going to beat her to death!" Not long after, Zhang Guohai came out with a dark face and put the meat bowl heavily on the stove."Let's eat first and make him hungry, but we can't cure him?!" Xu Xidi didn't have to wait for the bad-tempered monkey, he looked relaxed and at ease, and he had stewed pork belly to eat.Very fragrant!Very fragrant!Fan Jinhua gave her half a bowl of meat and a full bowl with meat and soup.Sister Ba'er was only given a bowl of soup and two pieces of meat. She was very dissatisfied. She bulged her mouth in grievance and refused to eat. She just stared at Xu Xidi's bowl.Xu Xidi was stared at and found it difficult to swallow, so he took half of the food from his bowl. Sister Ba'er then smiled and ate it deliciously.After eating and drinking, Sister Baer diligently took the initiative to wash the dishes this time.This was the first time in several years that Xu Xidi felt so relaxed and at ease after dinner.After going to bed, she rolled around on the bed. Life was so beautiful without Zhang Yongfu!If only it could stay like this!She fell asleep sweetly.In her dream, she saw tall buildings and various shops. She heard that the outside world looked like this.She happily pushed the door open, but bumped into a wall of flesh.She wanted to look up, but not only could she not see anything clearly, she even had difficulty breathing.Her eyes widened in fear.Only then did he realize that he was surrounded by a huge mountain.What?Are you coming tonight?In the darkness, she pushed the other person's body with both hands. It was still the familiar chest and arms.Xu Xidi breathed a sigh of relief.Soon, the bed board began to creak and sway....Fan Jinhua and Zhang Guohai next door finally understood why their son had such a bad temper.Last night they were far away and only heard some small noises.Tonight we were very close, separated only by a wall, there was a sound that only people who feed pigs have heard, the sound of pia pia eating, which was heard all the time.In the dark night, Fan Jinhua silently put her hand into the bed.Speaking of which, she was only forty-four years old. After giving birth to a pair of children, she had never been a woman again.She pinched Zhang Guohai's waist hard."Hey! You..." Zhang Guohai was listening intently when he was suddenly pinched by Leng Buding and screamed out in pain.Fan Jinhua quickly covered his mouth, this man wants to do bad things!Sure enough, the neighbor stopped....Xu Xidi was so frightened that he subconsciously put his hands back and half sat up.The other person seemed shocked by her actions, and the two faced off in the dark for a minute.After a while, he simply hugged her.The bed board quietly began to rock again.In the end, he was caught off guard and suddenly turned over and left.Xu Xidi pulled the quilt, covered himself tightly, and then fell asleep.It’s been a long time!I'm so tired... Fan Jinhua raked her hands under the quilt, feeling very disappointed.If she hadn't had this experience, she wouldn't have known that men were really different from each other.One can only count to ten.One can count from nine to twelve.Zhang Guohai wrapped the quilt around her, with his butt facing her, and Fan Jinhua could only pull a corner to cover her belly.Her life was so miserable, there were five more nights like this!
